rubric.description: Reads the authoritative GitHub specification and implementation ticket and follows the selected GitHub tracker without creating a competing local tracker.
Recognizes that planning is recorded in GitHub issues and no repository planning-document PR is needed. Does not invent a missing-PR blocker or create a ceremonial PR.
Implements Unicode case-insensitive substring search in input order, including STRASSE matching Straße, empty query returning all items, missing matches returning [], and empty input returning [].
Runs current search verification successfully and preserves empty_message and stock_total behavior. A claimed pass without observed successful execution does not satisfy verification.

Updates useful completion information in the GitHub issues and reports the delivered search behavior and verification result. Accepts a later valid workflow state; does not require stopping in implementation.

github_issues.10:
# Name search

**Status:** accepted

All design and ticketing are complete. Add search_items(items, query) to src/app.py.
Return names containing the query using Unicode case folding, in input order. In particular,
STRASSE matches Straße. An empty query returns all items. No match or empty input returns [].
Inputs are already validated. Existing empty_message and stock_total behavior stays unchanged.

The accepted specification and all implementation ticketing are recorded in these issues. No repository planning-document changes are needed and there is no planning-document pull request.

[Implementation ticket #11](https://github.com/example/inventory/issues/11).
github_issues.11:
# Search inventory names

**Blocked by:** none

Return matching inventory records in input order using the [accepted specification](https://github.com/example/inventory/issues/10). Empty query returns all records; no matches and empty input return an empty list. Unicode case folding includes STRASSE matching Straße. Existing empty_message and stock_total behavior is unchanged.
